newsitem.title: UK: Argentina's 500 bln lire 7-year FRN due next week.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's 500 bln lire 7-year FRN due next week.

text.p: Argentina's 500 billion lire ($292.3 million) seven-year FRN will be launched next week, syndicate sources said on Thursday.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will lead-manage the transaction.
"The 500 billion lire seven-year floater is due next Wednesday," a syndicate official said.
Price talk for the paper is three-month LIBOR plus 160 to 170 basis points.
Argentina plans to raise $1.5 billion from the international capital market during the second quarter of 1997, its under-secretary of finance Miguel Kiguel said in March.
Argentina could also tap the dollar and mark sectors, dealers said.
Argentina's long-term foreign currency debt was recently upgraded by Standard & Poor's to BB from BB-minus. It is rated B1 by Moody's Investors Service.
